notes: Collected 2026-10-19 from the DeepSeek official OpenAI-compatible API. deepseek-flash is a reasoning model; reasoning_effort="none" was sent via the probe() extraBody parameter so the model returns a final answer within the 16-token cap. Only English (en) at t=1 was collected. coin-flip and secret-password were collected but excluded from the contributed distribution: the July-2026 reference stores coin-flip as h/t while the current prompt/normalizer produces heads/tails (and localized equivalents), and the reference secret-password task is an invent-a-password task while the current lib/tasks.js prompt asks the model to echo PAMELA2026. prompts_sha256 is sha256(JSON.stringify(TASKS)) from lib/tasks.js; run_config_sha256 is sha256 of the collection object documented here.
